lines: Stone chips, tools chip, people chip too. Important thing is not breaking.
My hands shook too much to hold a chisel after. Still, they held long enough.
I made it back chipped around the edges, but not broken.
Stone dust in my sleeves, <dark_gray><wavy>fear</wavy></dark_gray> in my teeth, home under my feet.
A wall looks different after you have wished for one.
I kept moving one step at a time. That's how anything solid gets built.
The road tried to crack me. It failed.
I'll trust walls more tomorrow. Tonight I trust doors.
I carried a wounded neighbor until someone stronger took over.
The ground shook when the gate fell. I thought the whole village had gone with it.
I lost my pack and kept my life. That was a fair trade.
The shield beside me split and still bought us one more step.
I remember the quiet after the fighting more clearly than the noise.
There is blood on my apron that does not belong to me.
I counted breaths until I could hear the bell again.
Someone pulled me behind a wall when my legs stopped listening.
I know which stones held and which people did too.
My hands are steady enough to work. The rest of me may need a day.
I survived. I am not ready to turn it into a brave story.
Give me water, a chair, and a little time before the repairs begin.
